title: Bucharest easy + strides
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 45min easy-moderate, then 6x20s strides at 180+ spm with 60s walk. Deliberately the lighter of the two Bucharest days.
GYM: none.
FUEL: none.
STOP RULE: none, low-risk session by design.
WHY: protects the legs for Saturday/Sunday's back-to-back long block while keeping cadence sharp.
